gloss: to train one's ear; to get used to hearing

definitions.gloss: to train one's ear; to accustom one's ears to a sound or language
definitions.explanation: To gradually become accustomed to hearing a particular language, accent, music, or type of sound through repeated exposure. Commonly used in language learning contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{耳|みみ}を{慣|な}らすこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: First, it's important to train your ear to English.

examples.japanese: ポッド⟦キャスト→キャスト：10872_kyasuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{耳|みみ}を{慣|な}らして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I'm training my ear to Japanese by listening to podcasts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{現地|げんち}→現地：13502_genchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んで→住む：00673_sumu⟧⟦{方言|ほうげん}→方言：07419_hougen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{耳|みみ}を{慣|な}らす⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧。
examples.english: Living there and getting your ears accustomed to the dialect is the fastest way.

notes:
USAGE:
A useful expression for language learners. ⟦{慣|な}らす→慣らす：02390_narasu⟧ is the causative form of ⟦{慣|な}れる→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧ (to get used to), so the phrase literally means "to make one's ears become accustomed." Very commonly used when discussing listening practice for foreign languages.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{耳|みみ}を{慣|な}らす (to train one's ear to ~)
- {耳|みみ}を{慣|な}らす⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (in order to train one's ear)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{耳|みみ}→耳：01513_mimi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{慣|な}れる→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧: one's ears get used to it — the intransitive version
- ⟦{聞|き}き{取|と}れる→聞き取る：04583_kikitoru⟧⟦ようになる→ようになる：28408_youninaru⟧: to become able to catch/understand — the result of ear training
